paragraphs.text: Indris is a legendary otterfolk incarnation from Bloomburrow .

Indris is a colossal, element-suffused otterfolk incarnation made of swirling blue water crackling with pink and purple lightning. Towering above the landscape, this legendary creature appears in a stormy, turbulent environment, with dark clouds parting as beams of sunlight break through, highlighting its immense form. The water is composed of surges and flows as if driven by a powerful, unseen current. Below, small otterfolk boats struggle against the waves, their occupants dwarfed by the sheer force of Indris' presence, even as they form an electric bond with each other in a summoning ritual. Indris would be a powerful creature able to fight back against the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow , should the need arise.
